notes: Global Dec 2022; India Jan 2023 at Rs 39,999 (Amazon, sale Jan 9). Android 14 (HiOS 13.6/14) confirmed eligible+rolled; NOT eligible for HiOS 16. UW FOV not officially published (~120deg class claim unverified). UW has PDAF (input implied AF only on the Pro - corrected). Discontinued. Dimensity 9000 encoder rated MIXED: MediaTek MediaCodec encoders ignore frame timestamps (WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT), so CBR target tracking can drift under variable frame delivery - require isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) == true at compat-check. ARCore certification is a strong positive for IMU 100 Hz + REALTIME timestamp. Thermal: 4nm flagship SoC plausible for 25-min sustained but untested. Discontinued; was Rs 39,999.
